strings.Уровни API для работы с потоками: API levels for working with threads
strings.Одно ядро: потоки чередуются (context sw: One core: threads take turns (context switch)
strings.Main thread и фоновый поток: Main thread and a background thread
strings.Serial: задачи строго друг за другом: Serial: tasks strictly one after another
strings.Deadlock: задачи А и Б, ресурсы X и Y: Deadlock: tasks A and B, resources X and Y
strings.T4: lock X - занят, Б ждёт: T4: lock X - busy, B waits
strings.T5: lock Y - занят, А ждёт: T5: lock Y - busy, A waits
strings.А ждёт Б, Б ждёт А - DEADLOCK: A waits for B, B waits for A - DEADLOCK
strings.Цикл ожидания - никто никогда не продолж: A wait cycle - nobody will ever continue
strings.Инверсия приоритетов: T3-T4 высокий прио: Priority inversion: T3-T4 the high priority waits
strings.Deadlock: sync на ту же serial-очередь: Deadlock: sync onto the same serial queue
strings.B не может начаться, пока не закончится: B can't start until A finishes (serial!)
strings.A не закончится, пока не выполнится B: A won't finish until B runs
strings.barrier task: выполняется одна, остальны: barrier task: runs alone, the rest wait
strings.Mutex: два потока борются за замок: Mutex: two threads fight for a lock
strings.но операция ещё НЕ finished: but the operation is NOT finished yet
strings.Цикл в графе зависимостей: A cycle in the dependency graph
strings.Жизненный цикл sync и async операции: Life cycle of a sync and an async operation
strings.Continuations: один поток пула и приоста: Continuations: one pool thread and suspension at an await
strings.на каждую ожидающую задачу - поток: a thread for every waiting task
strings.цикл повторяется, пока его не остановят: the loop repeats until it is stopped

strings.Снизу вверх: Mach threads (самый низкий: From bottom to top: Mach threads (the lowest level, the OS kernel), POSIX threads pthread (C API, the UNIX standard), NSThread / Thread (Foundation, an OOP wrapper), GCD DispatchQueue (queues instead of threads). Above GCD there are two options: Operation / OperationQueue (OOP on top of GCD) and Swift Concurrency (async/await, Task, actor).

strings.Верхняя схема: одно ядро Core 1 по очере: Top diagram: a single core, Core 1, runs Thread 1, Thread 2, Thread 3, Thread 1, Thread 2 in turn (context switch at the boundaries). Bottom diagram: three cores work at the same time, Thread 1 on Core 1 from 0 to 10, Thread 2 on Core 2 from 0 to 7, Thread 3 on Core 3 from 1 to 9.

strings.Пользователь нажал Загрузить, Main threa: The user taps Download, the main thread starts the download on a background thread and stays free for scrolling, animations and touches. The background thread makes a network request and parses the response, returns the result to the main thread, and the main thread updates the user's screen.

strings.Два процесса, приложение A с тремя поток: Two processes: app A with three threads and app B with two. The threads of each process are connected to that process's shared memory. Between processes there is only IPC (a dashed link).

strings.Начальная точка, создание Thread() ведёт: A start point; creating Thread() leads to New. start() moves it to Runnable. The scheduler hands out a core: Runnable to Running; a context switch or an expired time slice: Running back to Runnable. From Running, on waiting for I/O, a lock or sleep, the thread goes to Blocked and returns to Runnable on the event. When the code finishes, Running moves to Terminated, then the end.

strings.Диаграмма последовательности: Код, Dispa: A sequence diagram: Code, DispatchGroup, Background tasks. The code calls enter() five times, the counter is 5; starts 5 downloads; subscribes via notify(queue:). The background tasks call leave() five times, the counter goes down 4, 3, 2, 1, 0. Then DispatchGroup calls the notify block in the code.

strings.Три колонки слева направо: ваш код (зада: Three columns from left to right: your code (tasks 1, 2, 3), DispatchQueue queues (main serial, global concurrent, custom serial or concurrent) and a thread pool managed by the system (the main thread and three Threads). Task 1 goes to main, task 2 to global, task 3 to custom. Main hands the work to the main thread, global to two threads, custom to one thread.

strings.Две шкалы времени от 0 до 11. Serial: Ta: Two timelines from 0 to 11. Serial: Task 0 from 0 to 3, Task 1 from 3 to 5, Task 2 from 5 to 9, Task 3 from 9 to 11, strictly one after another. Concurrent: Task 0 from 0 to 6, Task 1 from 1 to 4, Task 2 from 2 to 9, Task 3 from 3 to 5, the tasks overlap; they start in order and finish in any order.

strings.Диаграмма последовательности для queue1: A sequence diagram for queue1 (the current one) and queue2. Queue1 runs tasks 1 and 2. The sync block: queue1 calls queue2.sync with task 3, is blocked and waits, queue2 replies that task 3 is done. Then task 4 in queue1. The async block: queue1 calls queue2.async with task 3 and immediately runs task 4, while task 3 goes to queue2 in parallel.

strings.Диаграмма последовательности. Thread 1 и: A sequence diagram. Thread 1 and Thread 2 both read count = 0, each computes 0 + 1 = 1, then both write 1. The result: 1, not 2.

strings.Диаграмма последовательности: задача А (: A sequence diagram: task A (low) acquires resource X, then task B (high) preempts A, acquires Y, tries to take X and waits, A tries to take Y and waits. A waits for B, B waits for A: deadlock. Below is the wait-for graph: A holds X and waits for Y, B holds Y and waits for X, a wait cycle.

strings.Корень «Проблемы многопоточности» делитс: The root "Concurrency problems" splits into three groups. Uncertainty of parallelism: data race, race condition, actor reentrancy. Side effects of synchronization: deadlock, livelock, resource contention and performance penalty. Thread management mistakes: priority inversion, starvation, thread explosion.

strings.Диаграмма временных полос. Low захватыва: A timeline diagram. Low acquires the resource (0-2). High preempts Low and runs (2-3). At T3 High tries to take the busy resource and waits (3-6) while Low finishes up and releases it. At T4 (6) High gets the resource and runs (6-8). The gap T3-T4 is the inversion.

strings.В serialQueue стоят задача A, внутри кот: In serialQueue there are task A, inside which sync is called with task B, and then task B itself. A waits for B, but B can't start until A finishes, because the queue is serial. The result: deadlock.

strings.Диаграмма последовательности. Thread 1 д: A sequence diagram. Thread 1 does get and receives 0. Thread 2 does get and also receives 0. Thread 1 does set 1. Thread 2 does set 1. A note by the queue: each operation is atomic, but read-modify-write is not.

strings.Диаграмма временных полос, ось времени 0: A timeline diagram, time axis 0-10. Before the barrier: Task 1 from 0 to 3, Task 2 from 0 to 4, Task 3 from 1 to 4. The barrier task runs alone from 4 to 6. After the barrier: Task 5 from 6 to 8, Task 6 from 6 to 10, Task 7 from 7 to 9.

strings.Диаграмма последовательности. Thread 1 в: A sequence diagram. Thread 1 calls lock() on the Mutex and acquires it. Thread 2 calls lock(): it's busy, the thread goes to sleep. Thread 1 is in the critical section, then unlock(). The Mutex wakes Thread 2, which acquires the lock, goes through the critical section and calls unlock().

strings.Диаграмма последовательности. Один поток: A sequence diagram. One Thread and an NSRecursiveLock. lock(): counter 1. lock(): counter 2, the same owner, that's fine. unlock(): counter 1. lock(): counter 2. unlock(): counter 1. unlock(): counter 0, the lock is free for other threads.

strings.Дерево решений. От узла Нужно защитить о: A decision tree. From the node "Need to protect shared state" the questions go from top to bottom. New code on Swift Concurrency: yes, actor. Far more reads than writes: yes, concurrent queue + barrier. Need to limit the number of tasks to N: yes, DispatchSemaphore(value: N). Short critical section and speed matters: yes, os_unfair_lock / NSLock, then the question of whether the lock is taken recursively: yes, NSRecursiveLock; if the fourth question is no, serial DispatchQueue.

strings.Диаграмма последовательности: OperationQ: A sequence diagram: OperationQueue calls start() on AsyncOperation; the operation moves to the executing state and sends KVO isExecuting; sends a request with a callback to the Network; start() has already returned, but the operation is not finished yet; the Network responds; the operation sets the state to finished and sends KVO isExecuting and isFinished; then it tells the queue that dependent operations can be started.

strings.Три операции подряд: DownloadOperation,: Three operations in a row: DownloadOperation, then SaveOperation, then PDFGeneratorOperation; the arrows show the order of starting.

Queue 1 contains the chain Op1, Op2, Op3. Queue 2 contains Op5. Op2 waits for Op5 (an arrow from Op5 to Op2), Op5 waits for Op3 (a dashed arrow from Op3 to Op5). Op2, Op3, Op5 are highlighted: a cycle has formed.

strings.Два ряда. Sync: isReady, isExecuting, is: Two rows. Sync: isReady, isExecuting, isFinished; all the work in main; example code: let op = MdDocumentDownloadOperation(url) and op.start(). Async: isReady, isExecuting, an asynchronous task, isFinished; start returned, finish on the callback; example: let queue = OperationQueue() and queue.addOperation(MdDocumentDownloadOperation(url: url)).

strings.Диаграмма состояний Operation: создана и: The Operation state diagram: created and added to a queue, Pending; once dependencies are done, Ready; start() moves it to Executing; when the work is done, Finished; from Pending, Ready and Executing, on cancel() (for Executing, if the operation checks isCancelled), a transition to Cancelled; from Cancelled, leaving main or start leads to Finished; Finished is removed from the queue.

strings.Диаграмма последовательности: withdraw(8: A sequence diagram: withdraw(80) passes the guard 100 >= 80 and suspends at await log; withdraw(90) enters the free actor and also passes the guard 100 >= 90 and waits at await log; then W1 sets balance = 20, and W2 sets balance = -70, which is a bug.

strings.Две диаграммы времени. await подряд: pho: Two time diagrams. Consecutive awaits: photo1 from 0 to 3, photo2 from 3 to 6, photo3 from 6 to 9. async let: photo1 from 0 to 3, photo2 from 0 to 2, photo3 from 0 to 3, all in parallel.

strings.Сверху диаграмма последовательности: оди: At the top, a sequence diagram: one pool thread runs Continuation 1 up to an await, it suspends and the thread is free, then the thread runs Continuations 2 and 3, and finally returns to Continuation 1 and continues from where it stopped. At the bottom, a comparison: in GCD with blocking, each waiting task has its own thread; in Swift Concurrency one thread runs C1, C2, C3 in turn.

strings.Слева задачи Task 1-4 и Task N, справа c: On the left, tasks Task 1-4 and Task N; on the right, the cooperative pool with a thread count about equal to the number of cores: Thread 1, 2, 3. Task 1, 2, 3 go with solid arrows to Thread 1, 2, 3; Task 4 with a dashed arrow to Thread 1, Task N with a dashed arrow to Thread 2. The main thread is outside the pool, it is @MainActor.

strings.Структурированная: корневая Task порожда: Structured: the root Task spawns async let image1, async let image2 and withTaskGroup; withTaskGroup spawns three group.addTask. Unstructured, not connected to the tree: Task.detached and Task { } from elsewhere.

strings.Цикл из трёх шагов: wait (ждём событие),: A loop of three steps: wait (wait for an event), get (take it from the Event Queue), handle (handle it); after handle the loop goes back to wait.

strings.Цепочка состояний: Entry, BeforeTimers,: A chain of states: Entry, BeforeTimers, BeforeSources, ProcessSources, BeforeWaiting, Sleeping, AfterWaiting, HandleWakeUp; between the states observers get the notifications entry, beforeTimers, beforeSources, beforeWaiting, afterWaiting. After handling whatever woke it up, the loop returns to BeforeTimers, or on stop, no sources or a timeout goes to Exit and ends with the exit notification.

strings.Первое обращение к RunLoop.current созда: The first access to RunLoop.current creates the RunLoop (Created); run() moves it to Running; with no events it goes to Sleeping and returns to Running on an event or a timer; with no sources, a stop or a timeout it moves to Finished, after which the thread ends.

strings.Input sources (касания, порты, custom, p: Input sources (touches, ports, custom, performSelector) and Timer sources (Timer, afterDelay) arrive at the Run Loop inside a Thread; the Run Loop notifies observers and calls the handlers handlePort, customSrc, mySelector, timerFired.

strings.Вопрос «На каком потоке?»: на main испол: The question "Which thread?": on main you use Timer.scheduledTimer and RunLoop.main.add(timer, forMode: .common); on your own Thread you create a Timer(timeInterval:repeats:), add it to RunLoop.current in the .common mode and call RunLoop.current.run(); if it doesn't matter (background), you take a DispatchSourceTimer, which doesn't depend on RunLoop (see tutorial 02).

strings.Последовательность: RunLoop.main отправл: A sequence: RunLoop.main sends ticks to the timer in the .default mode; the user starts scrolling, the mode changes to .tracking, the timer doesn't fire; the user lifts the finger, the mode returns to .default, the ticks resume.
